shared_elements: figures stacked one above another on a vertical surface
relief carving of body forms with limbs
justification: Both show carved creatures distributed one above the other along the face of an upright monolithic shaft, which is the main correspondence, though it is a fairly generic scheme. The depicted content differs sharply: A shows flat, schematic quadrupeds in strict profile in shallow relief, while B shows volumetric, frontally facing heads with eyes and mouths, arms and bodies rendered nearly in the round, with no profile animals in comparable form.
